sample_reviews.author: Sarah M
sample_reviews.text: Wilsons came out the same day our boiler broke down in the middle of winter. Incredibly professional and had everything fixed within a couple of hours. Highly recommend!

sample_reviews.author: James T
sample_reviews.text: Really friendly and knowledgeable team. Fitted our new bathroom and the finish was excellent. Priced fairly and no hidden surprises on the invoice.

sample_reviews.author: Karen L
sample_reviews.text: Used Wilsons for our annual boiler service. Turned up on time, very tidy and explained everything clearly. Will be using them again.
